'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Typed sheet. Deck name '''Euro Emperor World Conquest (well...) Hunt Down (V)'''. Printed name Chris Menzel, 13.08.2011. Header cell V 07.05 is not a username. Printed lines sum to 61: Effects header reads 4 but five cards are listed; Interrupts header reads 12 but the quantities sum to 11. Character-block Black Leader (V) → Juno Eclipse, Black Leader (V). Victory (V) → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V). Galen, Secret Apprentice (V) → Galen Marek, Secret Apprentice (V). Saber Squadron Pilot and Saber Squadron TIE kept as written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
